name: Nameless
source: He is Eri's forgotten teddy bear, given to Eri by her grandfather. After being neglected by Eri, he was brought into the room where forgotten toys resided, and was confined there for 10 years. He then meets the Wizard who agrees to grant his desperate wish to see his owner again.
